projects.title: NYC Click to Cancel complaint portal
projects.description: The city's Office of Technology and Innovation built an online portal in 10 weeks where New Yorkers can file complaints against businesses that make subscriptions hard to cancel, under the municipal rule that took effect October 1. Filers get a complaint number and can check status.
projects.why_interesting: A working example of the city's in-house Public Interest Technology team shipping a civic tool fast, and a new complaint dataset to watch for.

projects.title: Streetsblog on NYC's stalled crash data
projects.description: Streetsblog reports that the city's open crash database has gone more than four months without an update, and that the Crashmapper and Crashcount tools built on it now carry out-of-date disclaimers.
projects.why_interesting: Shows how one stalled dataset breaks the outside maps that depend on it, a useful check for anyone building on NYC Open Data feeds.

projects.title: Baker Institute U.S. Data Centers and Infrastructure map
projects.description: Rice University's Baker Institute map layers existing and proposed U.S. data centers over fiber networks, transmission lines, power plants, water stress, electricity and gas prices, and county-level news sentiment.
projects.why_interesting: Puts data center siting next to the water and power constraints driving local fights, including the moratorium debates in upstate New York.

projects.title: Al Jazeera geospatial investigation of a West Bank settler attack
projects.description: Al Jazeera's Data Journalism Unit verified more than 20 videos and photos and mapped their locations to test an official account of an attack on a photojournalist.
projects.why_interesting: A clear model of open-source verification, matching geolocated media against a stated version of events.

projects.title: MonitorMamdani
projects.description: A public dashboard listed on the Civic Tech Guide that tracks Mayor Mamdani's promises and results using public data, alongside prediction-market odds and news coverage signals.
projects.why_interesting: One of several outside trackers of the new administration; worth comparing against the city's own LIFT tracker and open data.
